one_line: Classifies human nose shapes using a celebrity profile and 3D models based on a scientific study.

hook.what_happens: Dua Lipa's profile is shown alongside a scrolling selector of 3D nose shapes.
hook.why_it_works: Uses celebrity familiarity and interactive 3D visuals to spark curiosity.

shots.description: Dua Lipa's profile on the left with a scrolling vertical list of 3D nose models on the right.
A grid displaying 14 distinct nose shape classifications with 3D models.

devices.name: 3D nose model cards
devices.what_it_is: Rendered grey 3D models of different nose profiles.

devices.name: Academic citation card
devices.what_it_is: A small overlay box citing a journal study.

onscreen_text.text: RESEARCH-BASED Let's measure your Nose Shape
Based on this study: Tamir A. Numerical survey of the shapes of the human nose. J Craniofac Surg. 2011 May;22(3):1104-7. doi: 10.1097/SCS.0b013e318210b1b3. PMID: 21586956.

transcript.text: Let's measure your nose shape. Which nose type are you?

subjects: Dua Lipa (Singer/Songwriter) as the profile model

animations.name: Vertical List Scroll
animations.what_moves: Vertical list of nose shape cards on the right side
animations.purpose: Showcases the variety of nose shapes to build curiosity.
animations.reusable_as: Scrolling through product features, categories, or options.
animations.would_need_building: Vertical list carousel that scrolls continuously or step-by-step

animations.name: Citation Card Pop-In
animations.what_moves: Scientific study citation card on the left
animations.reusable_as: Displaying trust badges, reviews, or tooltips.

animations.name: Headline Crossfade
animations.purpose: Shifts the narrative from hook to interactive question.
animations.reusable_as: Updating call-to-actions or key benefits dynamically.

animations.name: Staggered Grid Reveal
animations.what_moves: A 3x5 grid of nose shape illustrations
animations.purpose: Presents the full taxonomy at once, prompting viewer interaction.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying a product catalog or feature overview at the end.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements pop in with scale and fade, or scroll vertically into view.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out to make room for the final grid transition.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: A clean fade transition from the single-profile view to the full grid view.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The background profile image of the model remains static for most of the video.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Constant and steady scrolling on the right, punctuated by quick UI pops on the left.

what_we_should_steal: Continuous vertical list scroll for showcasing options
Staggered grid pop-in for clean, structured outro screens
